---
title: "NQC Probs"
format: html
---

Load in packages:
```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(tidyverse)
```


Read in data:
```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
tbl_pointer <- tbl(con, "read_parquet('CAISO_dam_big.parquet')")

nqc <- readxl::read_xlsx("NQC_2024_sorted.xlsx")
```


Get max capacity for each month, each id:
```{r}
observed_max <- tbl_pointer |>
    group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, mo = month(as.Date(STARTTIME))) |>
    filter(!is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA),
           RESOURCE_TYPE == "GENERATOR") |>
    slice_max(n=1, order_by = SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, mo, SCH_BID_XAXISDATA) |>
    collect()
```


Compare observed max capacity to NQC:
```{r}
check_capacity <- function(id, obs_max, month, nqc_data){

    # pull month column of NQC data
    nqc_month <- tibble(nqc_data$`Generator Name`,
                        nqc_data[str_to_upper(month.abb[month])])
    names(nqc_month) <- c("generator", "capacity")

    # filter to generators with max capacities greater than observed max
    nqc_month |>
        filter(capacity >= obs_max) |>
        mutate(prob = 1/n(),
               id = id,
               month = month)
}

check_capacity(952796, 880, 6, nqc)
```


Repeat for all ids:

```{r}
check_probs <- function(obs_max_df){
    out <- tibble()

    for(id in obs_max_df$RESOURCEBID_SEQ){
        one_id_probs <- tibble()

        one_id <- obs_max_df |>
            filter(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == id)

        for(month in one_id$mo){
            one_month_prob <- check_capacity(id, one_id$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA[one_id$mo == month], month, nqc)

            one_id_probs <- bind_rows(one_id_probs, one_month_prob)
        }
        
        out <- bind_rows(out, one_id_probs)
    }

    return(out)
}

test_df <- tibble(
    RESOURCEBID_SEQ = c(952796, 525442),
    mo = c(6, 2),
    SCH_BID_XAXISDATA = c(880, 120)
)

check_probs(test_df)
```
